title: Layer 1 Artifact Structure (per artifact type)
description: The well-formed structure an agent retrieves to generate a conforming artifact of a given type. Contains NO detection logic (FR-004). One file per artifact type at knowledge/layer1/<type>/structure.yaml. A type whose source is not retained is served as the pending-source variant (FR-005).

source_id.description: Resolvable definition source for this structure (FR-005).

id.description: Type-specific segment id (e.g. system_response, role, given, modality, target, term).

ordering.description: Segment ids in required order, where ordering is meaningful for this type.

enumerations.description: Type-specific enumerations (FR-002), e.g. functional: condition_types + patterns; acceptance_criteria: ears_patterns; user_story: invest_attributes; non_functional (QAS): quality_characteristics + response_measure requirement; constraint: deontic_modalities; glossary_term: definition well-formedness rules.
